proposals.evidence: Full *savēla article gives Awankari savēl/savēlā/savēlē in the morning, Punjabi saver morning/dawn, and Gujarati saveḷā/saverā. Both alternatives of savela / savele belong to this family and are preserved as one source response. Bundeli suvere preserves the initial vowel variation; Bhili haver preserves the regional s-to-h correspondence. Local IA transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: savela / savele.
